name: variants/pseudo-element-terminal
description: Pseudo-element variants (`before`, `after`, `placeholder`, `marker`, `selection`, `file`, `backdrop`, `first-letter`, `first-line`) are CSS-terminal — the `::pseudo-element` portion must sit at the end of the compound selector regardless of where the variant lands in the source-order stack. Mirrors upstream PostCSS's selector normalisation: `checked:before:foo` produces `.foo:checked::before`, NOT `.foo::before:checked`. Likewise `dark:placeholder:foo` -> `.foo:is(.dark *)::placeholder`.
